program.storage_note: The pinned rendered HTML is preserved byte-for-byte under upstream/; the deterministic extracted listing is generated by scripts/extract_fannkuch_source.py.

extracted_source.method: HTMLParser selects the first pre block after the source-code h2; span markup is discarded and text entities decoded; outer whitespace normalized to one trailing newline.

adapted_source.method: Exact counted replacements remove host includes and CLI, expose checksum through an output parameter, and append checked benchmark/verifier wrappers.

Verified the repository license text and recorded Git blob IDs and SHA-256 hashes.
Preserved the pinned HTML and BSD-3-Clause license byte-for-byte.
Deterministically extracted the source listing and applied only the reviewed freestanding ABI adapter.
Host-compared the unmodified N=7 program to exact oracle bytes and tested the adapted firmware ABI, output encoding, boundaries, and corruption rejection.
